data.one_liner: Change the badge on the app icon on supported platforms.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to programmatically update, remove, or check support for app icon badges. Supports iOS, Android (via Shortcut Badger), macOS, Windows, and Linux.
use_when: You need to show unread message counts or alerts on the app icon.
You want to check if badge functionality is supported on the current device.
avoid_when: You require official, guaranteed badge support across all Android devices.
You are looking for a complete push notification solution rather than just icon badges.
strengths: Simple imperative API to update and remove badges.
Supports multiple platforms including iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, and Linux.
weaknesses: Android lacks a single official API, relying instead on Shortcut Badger which only supports select devices and launchers.
Windows and Linux implementations are noted as work in progress.
data.setup_notes: On iOS, notification permission is required and Info.plist needs UIBackgroundModes with remote-notification.
